fields.name: SS Code value
fields.description: The coding of the SS Code value is given in clause 17.7.5 of 3GPP TS 29.002 [15C]

notes: The purpose of the SS code information element is to convey information related to a network initiated supplementary service request to a CS fallback capable UE.
The SS Code is a type 3 information element with 2 octets length.
